results.name: Flood in Latvia and Lithuania
results.reason: On the 22 August 2026, a severe low-pressure system is affecting Latvia. The event is ongoing, bringing very heavy rainfall and damaging winds. Rainfall totals of up to 44 mm have already been recorded during the first half of the day, with further precipitation expected. The total accumulated precipitation may locally reach 60–80 mm, particularly in western Latvia, where a red-level warning is in force. Wind gusts are forecasted to reach 25–30 m/s during the evening, increasing the risk of fallen trees, damage to buildings and infrastructure, and risking power outages. The combination of intense and prolonged rainfall, saturated soils and strong winds is expected to result in significant local impact. Local flooding is anticipated during the following day, with risk to affect settlements, roads, agricultural areas and other infrastructure. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide flood extent and damage assessment emergency mapping.
